what_this_is: The A0-SEMANTIC discharge table, adopted by owner ruling 2026-08-27 (R2 of workflow wf_1c3df27b's verdict; the ruling also adopted R3). For a target body, every callee its reachable-closure walk finds OUTSIDE the spliced instruction-bearing prefix must carry exactly one clause: (a) REACHED-AND-MODELLED -- an explicit model in the proof module with its residual NAMED, never a silence, and never counted as a proof; or (b) UNREACHABLE-AND-PROVED -- a kernel-checked theorem in the same calculus as A4/A5. scripts/crystal_a0_census.py --discharge validates this table against the walk FAIL-CLOSED: an escaping callee with no entry is a FAIL, and an entry naming a callee the walk does not find is a REFUSAL (a table wider than reality is how residuals hide).

ruling.what: bodyful_reachable_closure as written demands a Rust body for a path that terminates at `_Unwind_RaiseException` (unsafe extern "C-unwind", unwind/src/libunwind.rs:290) -- a C symbol with no Rust body anywhere. Ruled a FLOOR, not a lowering gap (workflow wf_1c3df27b mechanism M2, plus M1/M3/M4 each independently sufficient). The semantic criterion replaces it AS THE COMPLETION CRITERION; the syntactic cell stays computed and reported beside it, unhidden.
